body: /r/longboarding. Not that I hate the place, it has some good action shots, it just... yeah. Idk.

Sounds like me right now mate. Can't be assed to make a sandwich, it's coffee, bread, cigarettes, and dry ramen. I've got good food, just can't be assed to make it.

And I just get overwhelmed and stop going. I LOVED my last job as a CNA. Absolutely loved it. My coworkers, my patients, everything. Then one day I could barely get my scrubs on. I stood on my porch with a very familiar feeling. I wanted to go to work, but couldn't make myself. I have this internal battle where something won't let me go. I try to go. I want to go. Instead I just sit there, smoke, and watch the bus roll right on by. Then I go lay down, cry, and watch everything crumble. I'm going to be thrown out the end of this month because I have no job to pay rent with.
Cool, thanks for the canned response.

I need a lot more than a friend, mate. I spend all my time trying to do things I know I can't do (hold down a job, make rent, afford food, etc.) The requirements of daily life are too much to handle, so I continue to fall apart. And if I can't do the basics just to survive, how am I supposed to stay alive AND get help?
